capabilities: Highlight text and freehand areas in PDFs
Draw freehand ink with pressure-sensitive stylus support
Type text boxes onto PDF pages
Attach, read and edit notes on highlights
Store annotations in per-device vault files that merge automatically
disambiguation: Not just a text highlighter; it also provides freehand pen strokes, text boxes, an eraser and notes attached to highlights.
extras: Annotations are stored in separate vault files, so other PDF viewers will not display them and there is no export-to-PDF yet. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Highlighter adds a full annotation toolbar to Obsidian's built-in PDF viewer.
problem: Obsidian can display PDFs but offers no tools to mark them up, so annotating means leaving the app for an external PDF editor.

relations.evidence: Add this repository in the BRAT plugin and enable Highlighter.

summary: PDF annotation layer that adds highlighting, freehand ink, text boxes and per-highlight notes to Obsidian's built-in PDF viewer.
